# 2 Clement — Chapter 14 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 14
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Brothers, if we do the will of God our Father, we will belong to the first church — the spiritual one, the one created before the sun and moon existed. But if we fail to do the Lord's will, we will belong to the company scripture describes when it says: "My house has become a den of robbers." So let us choose to belong to the church of life, so that we may be saved.
2. I don't think you are unaware that the living church is the body of Christ. Scripture says: "God made the human being male and female." The male is Christ; the female is the church. And both the scriptures and the apostles declare that the church does not belong to the present age — she existed before everything. She was spiritual, just as Jesus our Lord was spiritual, and she was revealed in the last days so that she could save us.
3. The church, being spiritual, appeared in the flesh of Christ. This tells us: if we guard our flesh and do not corrupt it, we will receive it back in the Holy Spirit.
4. For this flesh is the antitype and image of the Spirit. Whoever corrupts the copy will not receive the original.
5. What he means, brothers, is this: guard the flesh so that you may receive the Spirit.
6. But look at it from another angle: the flesh is the church, and the Spirit is Christ. So whoever mistreats the flesh has mistreated the church. That person will not receive the Spirit — who is Christ.
7. This flesh is capable of receiving such great life and immortality — if the Holy Spirit is joined to it. No one can speak or describe what the Lord has prepared for his chosen.
